statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-58012 is a buffer over-read of a few bytes in g_regex_replace (glib/gregex.c) when a regex compiled with G_REGEX_RAW uses case-changing replacement escapes on input that is not valid UTF-8, which can disclose a few bytes or cause a denial of service. Upstream fixed it in GLib 2.86.5, 2.88.1 and 2.89.0 (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/issues/3918), and Debian backported the fix to trixie in 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-58012). This owner rebuilds Debian's trixie glib2.0 source. We unpacked libglib2.0-0t64 from every published build for amd64 and arm64. The three builds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u3 do not carry the fix: their package changelog has no entry for this CVE. The three builds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u5 do: their changelog includes the 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 entry that adds the patches from upstream 2.86.5 (the gregex G_REGEX_RAW case-change patch) and names this CVE. The range ends at the first build of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u5, the first published build with the fix.
